chapters.name: Orbit
chapters.describe: The International Space Station circles the Earth. No lightning yet, so only the pad plays, quiet and dark.

chapters.name: One day
chapters.describe: 1 March 2017. As the station passes over each storm, a single chime rings. Higher notes mean storms further north.

chapters.name: Six years
chapters.describe: The whole planet, 2017 to 2023. The beat drops in. More lightning opens the pad and fills the reverb; sudden surges become hi-hat rolls.
